{{Top}}
[[File:Datacard.png|thumb|250px|A datacard being inserted into R2-D2]]

The '''datacard''' was used to transfer and store large amounts of information. A group of datacards was called a '''datapack'''. Alternative data storage and retrieval devices were '''datadiscs''' or [[Dataplaque/Legends|data plaques]]. Two large datadisc manufacturers were [[Corellia Digital]] and the [[Bay-Suwe Combine]]. 

==Description==
A specialized data disk that was used to store personal information was called a '''journal disk'''.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|174|journal disk}}</ref> 

A '''[[transfer chip]]''', also known as a '''data-transfer chip''', were datacards that can transfer [[Currency/Legends|credits]] between different creature's accounts. This method was used around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The transfer chip's features included a miniaturized input module and the ability to instantly transfer credits to bank accounts in a variety of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Access to a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that had a verify-and-transmit connection with the local [[Bank/Legends|banking exchange]] was necessary.

Datacards that are use to store data storage of data having to do with [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] are called '''astrogation data cards''',<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> or '''astrogation chip'''. One such datacard contained [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]]'s information on [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]].<ref name="Silent Fury">{{JournalCite|7|Silent Fury}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Datadisk.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Hologram disc/Legends|hologram disc]], an alternative data storage device]]
Large libraries of datacards existed around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], holding enormous quantities of data. The largest was at [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], before the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] destroyed the library.

Data cards were one of the primary methods of information storage in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]], and could be accessed with data terminals.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] were [[Mission to Christophsis (datapacks)|sent]] to [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to retrieve a number of datapacks, containing vital information, before the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, which had overrun the planet, could get their hands on them.

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] carried a datacard containing the plans to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] that was given to him by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]] during the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shortly before her capture by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].

During the Galactic Civil War, various spacers who sought treasure also found some datadisks that contained maps to various treasures, of which at least nine existed.

==Behind the scenes==
Datacards store and transfer data to and from [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] in the same way real-world [[Wikipedia:USB flash drive|USB flash drives]] are used with [[Wikipedia:computer|computers]]. They can be used in the way a [[Wikipedia:smartphone|smartphone]] reads secure digital (SD) cards. This fictional technology was shown on-screen decades before the real-world devices existed.
